verdict.rationale: Increase exposes rail-level data without an abstraction layer: ACH addenda, granular card network data, and low-level rail access. It also correlates returns with their originating transfers and lets each counterparty get a unique Account Number for automatic matching. However, the evidence never documents transaction object fields, stable identifiers, or any enrichment layer that would make a raw feed product-ready. missing for 10: documented transaction schema with counterparty fields, explicit stable/idempotent identifiers, enrichment (merchant cleanup, categorization), independent hands-on corroboration.
